visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a neutral gaze sits on a dark brown wooden bench. She wears a black leather jacket, silver necklaces, and silver rings on her fingers while looking directly at the camera lens. Beside her is a large statue of Nick Wilde, a fox character wearing a purple shirt and floral tie. The background is a stark white brick wall under bright, natural daylight. (2) The woman stands and moves between various photo spots, making an exaggeratedly wide-eyed, surprised face with her mouth open. She points one hand upwards while holding a black quilted bag. A statue of Flash the sloth is visible behind her, featuring a similar open-mouthed expression. The setting is an outdoor pedestrian area with white and blue wall decals and posters. (3) She continues her tour, posing next to a green Zootopia-themed traffic light and holding up a smartphone to take a high-angle selfie. She smiles broadly and mimics character expressions shown in on-screen overlays, such as a wide-mouthed scream and a polite, hands-clasped pose. The background includes a large white tree decorated with ornaments and posters for Zootopia events.
